keep.text: Sabhi log health ko unnecessarily bahut zyada complicate karke batate hain. But asli secret ye sirf 4 cheezein hain
aur ye 4 cheezein kya hain, ye koi nahi batata. Kyunki agar ye log batane lage toh inka supplement ka market poora khatam ho jaayega, aur inke gym ki membership koi nahi lega
Main batata hoon 4 cheezein. Fasting, kab khana hai
kab nahi khana hai. Diet, kya khana hai aur kitna khana hai. Exercise, kaun si karni hai, kitni karni hai, kab karni hai, ghar se karni hai ya gym se karni hai,
aur sabse important part, meditation, stress,
sleep, anxiety. Ye fix karna bahut zyada important hai. Agar yahi fix nahi hua aap logon ka, toh pichhli jo 3 cheezein hain, woh bhi sahi tareeke se nahi hongi.

Aur ye 4 cheezon ko maine ek system mein daal diya hai. Main 110 kilo se aaj 85 kilo pe aa chuka hoon. 85 pe mera body fat aaj ke time pe 15% hai. 30 din pehle mera body fat 26.9% tha. Aur 30 din mein
kareeban kareeban 10 kilo vajan ghataya hua hoon, aur 10 ki 10 kilo
Par sabse important baat pata hai kya hai? Ye system poora ka poora personalized hona chahiye. Ek hi system sab ke liye nahi chalta hai. Sab ki body type alag-alag hai,
toh alag-alag body type ke liye alag-alag system.
Toh isko seekhna bahut zyada important hai.
Ye poora system main ek live webinar mein aap logon ko dikha dunga. Aapke liye personalized kaise banana hai, kaise nahi banana hai, ye aap khud decide kar loge.
Link neeche hai, abhi join kariye. Webinar, milte hain webinar mein!
